messages.The theme or a preset overrides this fea: The theme or a preset overrides this feature in code (flxp_pagespeed_enabled); this setting may not take effect.
messages.Saved. The cache and the LiteSpeed page: Saved. The cache and the LiteSpeed page cache were cleared; browse a few pages to check.
messages.Google PageSpeed / Lighthouse suggestion: Google PageSpeed / Lighthouse suggestions that can be applied without changing the theme. Each one is switched on separately; after enabling a "Test first" item, check a few pages of the site (home, a post, donation/checkout).
messages.user-scalable=no and maximum-scale are r: user-scalable=no and maximum-scale are removed from the viewport tag so visitors with low vision can zoom in. Directly affects the Accessibility score.
messages.WordPress's emoji detection script and s: WordPress's emoji detection script and style are not loaded. Modern browsers render emoji themselves.
messages.Trimmed CSS is written into <head> up to: Trimmed CSS is written into <head> up to this size; anything beyond is loaded as a separate cached file. 0 = always a file.
One class or id per line, * as wildcard. If a style added later by JavaScript breaks, add its class here. is-*, has-*, wp-*, swiper-* are always kept.
messages.Remove unused CSS and inline it: Remove unused CSS and inline it
messages.Each page's class/id inventory is collec: Each page's class/id inventory is collected (HTML + the page's scripts); rules with no match on that page are dropped from the CSS file and the rest is written into <head>. The render-blocking CSS request goes away and LCP/FCP improve. Pages with the same inventory share one copy; copies are rebuilt when the file changes, and the full file is used if there are too many different pages.
messages.For unminified (non-.min) local CSS file: For unminified (non-.min) local CSS files, an up-to-date .min sibling or a copy without comments and whitespace is used.
messages.For theme and plugin scripts, the .min s: For theme and plugin scripts, the .min sibling is used if it is newer than the source; otherwise a copy without comments and indentation is generated (line breaks are kept). Bundles that load chunks relative to their own location and scripts with translations are left alone.
messages.jQuery always stays blocking (older inli: jQuery always stays blocking (older inline scripts on the page may call it directly). WordPress itself drops defer for scripts that have an inline script after them or that a blocking script depends on.
messages.Scripts loaded in the page <head> that h: Scripts loaded in the page <head> that hold up rendering get defer (e.g. language suggestion, analytics scripts).
messages.Font families defined in theme.json but: Font families defined in theme.json but not referenced in the page's CSS (@font-face) are not printed. If usage cannot be determined, nothing is removed.
messages.The regular (400) woff2 of up to two fam: The regular (400) woff2 of up to two families in use is requested with <link rel="preload"> so text paints sooner. Preloading the wrong weight wastes a download; turn this off if PageSpeed reports an unused preload.
messages.One handle or part of a URL per line. Tr: One handle or part of a URL per line. Trimming, minifying and defer are not applied to these files.
messages.One URL part per line. No PageSpeed opti: One URL part per line. No PageSpeed optimization runs on these pages.
messages.Adding ?flxp_off=1 to a URL opens the pa: Adding ?flxp_off=1 to a URL opens the page without optimizations; if the page looks different, the cause is here.
messages.The site audit suggests these settings i: The site audit suggests these settings itself and turns them on with one click.
messages.Animations not running on the GPU: Animations not running on the GPU
messages.Lighthouse \"non-composited animations\": Lighthouse "non-composited animations": properties other than transform and opacity (stroke-dashoffset, background, width…) repaint every frame. A setting cannot fix this; the theme or preset must rewrite them with transform/opacity.
messages.All good: animations in the CSS files se: All good: animations in the CSS files seen use transform/opacity.
messages.Scanned %1$d CSS files seen on the front: Scanned %1$d CSS files seen on the front end (%2$s).
messages.The front end has not been seen yet, so: The front end has not been seen yet, so the theme folder was scanned. Once the site is opened, the files the page loads are scanned.
messages.Custom login URL turned off; login is ba: Custom login URL turned off; login is back on wp-login.php.
messages.You are being logged out so you can see: You are being logged out so you can see the new address work; you will be redirected to the new login page in %s seconds. After logging in you come back to this screen.
messages.Redirect stopped. You are still logged i: Redirect stopped. You are still logged in; the new address is used the next time you log in.
You are not allowed to view this page.
messages.Recording is off: only the live panel wo: Recording is off: only the live panel works.
messages.\"Profile page\" opens the URL as a visi: "Profile page" opens the URL as a visitor (bypassing cache) and records it in full detail.
messages.No records yet. Slow or failing requests: No records yet. Slow or failing requests and sampled requests appear here.
messages.Times are calculated from recorded reque: Times are calculated from recorded requests: sampled requests plus slow/failing ones, so the average may look higher than the real average.
messages.The time visitors wait is the \"Front en: The time visitors wait is the "Front end" row. Cron, Ajax and REST are mostly background work (backup step, scheduled task, Heartbeat); when they take long they do not slow pages directly, but they keep the server busy.
messages.Shared hosting: account limit cannot be: Shared hosting: account limit cannot be read
messages.These values belong to every account on: These values belong to every account on the machine; they are not your site's usage or limit.
messages.No data (disabled or not allowed by the: No data (disabled or not allowed by the server).
messages.Safe jobs only: posts, pages and revisio: Safe jobs only: posts, pages and revisions are never deleted. Limit revisions with WP_POST_REVISIONS in wp-config.
messages.These options are loaded from the databa: These options are loaded from the database on every request. Over 800 KB in total slows pages down; shrink the setting or cache in the plugin that owns the large rows.
messages.WordPress cron is disabled: events run o: WordPress cron is disabled: events run only when a server cron job calls wp-cron.php. On Hostinger, add a cron job that calls it every 5 minutes.
messages.Measured per task each time wp-cron.php: Measured per task each time wp-cron.php runs; sorted by total time. A summary older than a day resets when the task runs again. "Cut off": the task hit the time limit and stopped halfway.
messages.Show a summary in the admin bar and a bo: Show a summary in the admin bar and a bottom panel to authorized users
messages.Show on the front end too: Show on the front end too
messages.The panel is visible to administrators a: The panel is visible to administrators and to staff granted "View performance" by Flux Roles.
messages.Also record my own requests while the pa: Also record my own requests while the panel is on (only when something is wrong)
messages.This share of requests is collected in d: This share of requests is collected in detail (with the query list) and recorded. 1-5 is recommended on Hostinger; 0 turns it off.
messages.Your shared hosting plan's disk limit (H: Your shared hosting plan's disk limit (Hostinger: hPanel › Account resources). PHP cannot read it; when set, the Disk card shows account usage as a percentage. Leave empty to show used space only.
messages.The data is read by read-only tools on t: The data is read by read-only tools on the Flux AI & MCP server and in Flux AI chat: flxp_summary, flxp_requests, flxp_request, flxp_slow_queries, flxp_php_errors, flxp_http_calls, flxp_environment, flxp_server, flxp_database, flxp_autoload, flxp_cron, flxp_profile_url.
messages.Flux AI & MCP is active: tools are regis: Flux AI & MCP is active: tools are registered.
messages.Flux AI & MCP is not active: tools are a: Flux AI & MCP is not active: tools are available in Flux AI chat only.
messages.Opens the login screen at an address of: Opens the login screen at an address of your own instead of wp-login.php. wp-login.php and wp-admin requests from logged-out visitors no longer respond, which cuts bot password guessing and server load.
messages.FLXP_LOGIN_DISABLE is defined in wp-conf: FLXP_LOGIN_DISABLE is defined in wp-config.php: the custom URL is off and login uses wp-login.php. Remove that line once the problem is solved.
messages.Bookmark this address and share it with: Bookmark this address and share it with everyone who logs in. If you forget it, use the recovery step below.
messages.The address comes from the FLXP_LOGIN_SL: The address comes from the FLXP_LOGIN_SLUG constant in wp-config.php; edit or remove the constant to change it.
messages.Leave empty to use the standard WordPres: Leave empty to use the standard WordPress address (wp-login.php). 3-40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen, underscore. Pick something hard to guess (admin and login are not allowed).
messages.Applies to wp-login.php and to wp-admin: Applies to wp-login.php and to wp-admin requests from logged-out visitors. admin-ajax.php, admin-post.php, the REST API, wp-cron, WooCommerce My Account login and the Flux App connection are not affected.
messages.If you forget the address or login won't: If you forget the address or login won't open: add the line below to wp-config.php using your file manager (Hostinger hPanel › File Manager). Login goes back to wp-login.php; once you're in, fix the address here and remove the line.
messages.CPU and memory are measured against this: CPU and memory are measured against this account's (container/cgroup) limit.
messages.Shared hosting: PHP sees the CPU, memory: Shared hosting: PHP sees the CPU, memory and disk shared by every account on the machine; these are not your values and are not shown. Your account's CPU and memory usage is in the hosting panel (Hostinger: hPanel › Account resources).
messages.Enter your hosting plan's disk quota in: Enter your hosting plan's disk quota in Settings to see a disk percentage.
messages.The login URL must be 3-40 characters; u: The login URL must be 3-40 characters; use only lowercase letters (a-z), digits, hyphens and underscores.
messages.WordPress already uses this address; pic: WordPress already uses this address; pick another name.
messages.A page or post already uses this address: A page or post already uses this address; pick another name.
messages.The login URL has changed. Bookmark this: The login URL has changed. Bookmark this page and log in again.
messages.Flux Speed: remove unused CSS and inline: Flux Speed: remove unused CSS and inline it
messages.Drops theme CSS rules the page does not: Drops theme CSS rules the page does not use and writes the rest into <head>, removing the render-blocking CSS request. Check a few pages first; if something breaks, turn it off or add the class to the keep list.
messages.Flux Speed: minify CSS and JS files: Flux Speed: minify CSS and JS files
messages.Unminified theme and plugin CSS/JS files: Unminified theme and plugin CSS/JS files are served from an up-to-date .min version or a generated copy.
messages.Blocking scripts at the top of the page: Blocking scripts at the top of the page are loaded with defer. jQuery and excluded scripts are left alone.
messages.Flux Speed: remove the zoom lock: Flux Speed: remove the zoom lock
messages.user-scalable=no and maximum-scale are r: user-scalable=no and maximum-scale are removed from the viewport tag.
messages.theme.json fonts not used on the page ar: theme.json fonts not used on the page are removed and the above-the-fold font is preloaded.
messages.Flux Speed: remove the emoji script: Flux Speed: remove the emoji script
messages.WordPress's emoji detection script and s: WordPress's emoji detection script and style are not loaded; modern browsers render emoji themselves.
messages.Flux Speed › PageSpeed lists which anima: Flux Speed › PageSpeed lists which animation in which file is the problem.
messages.The matching Flux Speed setting is on; c: The matching Flux Speed setting is on; clear the cache (LiteSpeed Purge All) and measure again. Whatever remains is up to the theme/preset.
messages.Turned on. The page cache was cleared; r: Turned on. The page cache was cleared; run the site audit or PageSpeed test again.
messages.Animation not running on the GPU: %s. Sh: Animation not running on the GPU: %s. Should be rewritten with transform/opacity (theme/preset).
messages.Animations in the CSS files seen use tra: Animations in the CSS files seen use transform/opacity.
messages.The uploads/flx-speed folder is not writ: The uploads/flx-speed folder is not writable: CSS trimming and minifying will not work, pages load the original files.

messages.The table is not installed. Deactivate a: The table is not installed. Deactivate and reactivate the plugin.
messages.On: %1$d%% of requests are sampled; requ: On: %1$d%% of requests are sampled; requests over %2$d ms and failing requests are recorded.
messages.Off: only the live panel works; AI canno: Off: only the live panel works; AI cannot read history.
messages.Failing requests in the last 24 hours: Failing requests in the last 24 hours
messages.%1$d requests with PHP/server errors, %2: %1$d requests with PHP/server errors, %2$d fatal. See Records.
messages.Slow requests in the last 24 hours: Slow requests in the last 24 hours
messages.%d recorded requests had external servic: %d recorded requests had external service errors in the last 24 hours.
messages.SAVEQUERIES is on in wp-config.php: ever: SAVEQUERIES is on in wp-config.php: every request keeps all queries in memory. Flux Performance turns it on itself when needed; remove it from wp-config.
messages.MCP and Flux AI chat can read the record: MCP and Flux AI chat can read the records.
messages.Flux AI & MCP is not active or MCP is of: Flux AI & MCP is not active or MCP is off; tools are not visible.

messages.Under 800 KB is recommended; check the l: Under 800 KB is recommended; check the largest rows.

messages.Off: PHP files are compiled again on eve: Off: PHP files are compiled again on every request. Turn it on in Hostinger › PHP configuration.

messages.Each line shows something the site needs: Each line shows something the site needs and whether it is in place. Fix the errors first; warnings are worth a look.
messages.Show only these (click again to show all: Show only these (click again to show all)

messages.Query details were not collected for thi: Query details were not collected for this request (not sampled). Open the page while logged in as an administrator or raise the sampling rate.
